mapper.select: SELECT CAST(t.CREATE_TIME AS DATE) AS day_str, t.STATUS AS status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM DEV_CRON_JOB_LOG t WHERE t.CREATE_TIME >= #{start} AND t.CREATE_TIME <= #{end} GROUP BY CAST(t.CREATE_TIME AS DATE), t.STATUS ORDER BY day_str

SELECT CAST(t.CREATE_TIME AS DATE) AS day_str, t.JOB_ID AS jobId, m.JOB_NAME AS jobName, t.STATUS AS status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM DEV_CRON_JOB_LOG t LEFT JOIN DEV_CRON_JOB m ON t.JOB_ID = m.ID WHERE t.CREATE_TIME >= #{start} AND t.CREATE_TIME <= #{end} GROUP BY CAST(t.CREATE_TIME AS DATE), t.JOB_ID, m.JOB_NAME, t.STATUS ORDER BY day_str, t.JOB_ID
